checklist.item: one subject, one pedestal, no collage, no second view, no text, letters, logo or watermark;
checklist.note: One creature on one two-disc pedestal; no collage, second view, text, logo or watermark.

checklist.item: strict front orthographic view, camera exactly level, no perspective, no three-quarter turn; the pedestal is seen exactly edge-on, its top surface is not visible;
checklist.note: Face and torso are square to the camera. Both pedestal discs are edge-on, with straight horizontal edges and no visible top plane. No three-quarter turn or elevated camera is apparent.

checklist.item: the whole subject and pedestal visible, nothing cropped; plain flat dark gray background;
checklist.note: Entire horns, wings, tail, hooves and pedestal are visible on a plain charcoal gray background. Nothing is cropped.

checklist.item: No weapon or held object. (both arms clearly apart from the torso, not a T-pose, not an A-pose);
checklist.note: No weapon or held object. Viewer-left arm is raised with a clearly bent elbow, viewer-right arm hangs lower with a different elbow bend; both hands have visible separation from the torso. No A/T stance.

checklist.item: every identity anchor is visible: horse-like head with small horns; bat wings; hooved legs; forked tail;
checklist.note: Horse-like head with two short curved horns, two bat wings, hooved legs and a clearly forked tail between the legs are visible.

checklist.item: main colours and the accent of the palette are present; no team colour, no coloured ring or band on the base.
checklist.note: Dark brown hide, gray wing membranes, bone-coloured horns and red eyes are present. No strong team colour, coloured pedestal ring or metal band. Colour judged visually rather than requiring all shaded pixels to equal the palette HEX.

note: Selected: asymmetric bent elbows and darker hide address the supplied rework; edge-on pedestal fixes the g3 failure. All six visual CHECKLIST items pass. This is a proposed design, not artistic acceptance.
